description:
The mistake I made to Davi years ago came back as a dog collar that strangles Seonghyeon. Darby demands a relationship that resembles that of a master or servant. However, since it was not a simple humiliation or restraint, Seong-hyeon becomes more engrossed in her relationship with her main servant, Da-bi, rather than her lover, Su-min...?!

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/collar), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9268669), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/C000055239), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/9199)
